messages:
Aisha Khan: FYI found a batch replay that landed after the billing cutoff and applied token credits to Feb invoices. Not the usual prefix-replay. Posting summary.
Ravi Menon: can you share the job id and a short log snippet?
Aisha Khan: job `usage-backfill-20240614-02`. Audit log: 
```
2024-06-14T07:41:02Z WARN replay accepted job=usage-backfill-02 visibility_timeout=0 delayed_by=90000000
```
Aisha Khan: visibility_timeout=0 and delayed_by ~25h looks wrong. Suspect queue client bug that resets visibility on restart.
Elena Soto: billing-bot reports 58 invoices updated, total credits $4,230.00. billing-bot: ticket FIN-8011 created, priority P1.
billing-bot: FIN-8011 owners auto-assigned [Elena Soto, Ravi Menon, ops-oncall], labels: invoice-fix, delayed-replay.
Ravi Menon: containment plan: (1) pause invoice auto-amend (Elena), (2) pause backfill workers (ops-oncall), (3) run scope query for affected customers (Ravi).
Elena Soto: paused auto-amend flag `billing.auto_amend=false` at 1758887805. Confirm no further live amendments.
ops-oncall: paused backfill queue `usage-backfill` at 1758887810.
Ravi Menon: running scope query now. Early numbers: 142 unique accounts, ~9.7M tokens, rough MRR impact estimate $12k. Saving CSV to FIN-8011.
Aisha Khan: proposed owners and ETA:
- containment: Elena & ops-oncall 12h
- scope & canonical counts: Ravi  24h
- invoice corrections run & customer comms: Elena + finance ops  48h
- postmortem + longterm fix: Aisha + infra  1 week
Ravi Menon: root cause hypothesis: queue client on worker restart sets visibility to 0 if env var `VISIBILITY_MS` missing; default should be 300000. Working on a patch to ensure defaults and add guardrails.
Elena Soto: can we create a manual review for accounts with >$500 impact? I'll sign off those first.
ops-oncall: created review list FIN-8011-REVIEW and added top 25 accounts.
Aisha Khan: monitoring ask: add metric `billing.delayed_replay_tokens` and alert when >1000 tokens in a 5m window. Also emit event on job acceptance with delay_ms tag.
Ravi Menon: will instrument. Also adding a webhook to FIN tickets for new replay events so finance sees realtime alerts.
billing-bot: FIN-8011 updated: owners [Elena Soto, Ravi Menon, Aisha Khan], due_dates [containment:2024-06-14T12:00Z, scope:2024-06-15T07:41Z, invoice_corrections:2024-06-16T07:41Z, postmortem:2024-06-21T07:41Z].
Elena Soto: customer comms draft uploaded to FIN-8011. Short note: "We identified a delayed replay that affected billing windows; were correcting invoices and will notify impacted customers."
Ravi Menon: quick checklist for invoice correction run: (1) canonical token counts per invoice window, (2) compute delta vs current invoice, (3) for positive credit issue credit note, for negative adjust invoice and notify, (4) QA on 10 sample accounts.
Aisha Khan: timeline question: if we fix the queue client tomorrow, how many backlog replays may still trigger? ops-oncall?
ops-oncall: paused workers but there are 3 queued jobs with delay tags > 24h; we'll inspect and delete if needed.
Elena Soto: recommend sending top-affected customers a heads-up before final invoice fix. I'll coordinate with CS.
Ravi Menon: I'll attach export and token reconciliation script to FIN-8011.
Aisha Khan: long-term mitigations to include in postmortem: default visibility guard, add replay TTL after billing cutoff, emit replay audit events to event-stream, dashboard for daily delayed replay counts, and periodic drill run.
Elena Soto: agreed. Also recommend runbook update: billing engineers must disable auto-amend before any mass-replay ops.
ops-oncall: removed the 3 queued jobs at 1758887880. No new replays running.
Aisha Khan: final asks: (1) Ravi - finish canonical counts and attach CSV, (2) Elena - coordinate credits + CS outreach, (3) ops-oncall - add alert and remove any lingering backlog.
Ravi Menon: CSV uploaded to FIN-8011, will send sample QA notes by EOD.
Elena Soto: outreach scheduled, invoice correction job ready to run pending sign-off.
ops-oncall: alert `billing.delayed_replay_tokens > 1000 (5m)` added and will page oncall.
Aisha Khan: thanks team. I'll author the postmortem and link FIN-8011. Follow-up in one week for lessons learned and action closure. :thumbsup:
